WITH
  main AS (
  SELECT
    * EXCEPT (cost,
      clicks,
      impressions,
      SOURCE,
      medium,
      Network_with_search_partners__AdWords,
      month,
      year,
      currency,
      Data_Source_name,
      Data_Source_id,
      account_ID,
      CampaignID,
      Data_Origin_Identifier),
    LOWER(SOURCE) AS SOURCE,
    LOWER(medium) AS medium,
    LOWER(Network_with_search_partners__AdWords) AS google_ad_network,
    "" AS ad_content,
    SUM(cost) AS cost,
    SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
    SUM(impressions) AS impressions
  FROM
    `snproject-cbb9ca25`.`RM_adspend`.`rm_adspend_static`
    
  WHERE date BETWEEN 
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-01') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )
        AND
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-05') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )

  GROUP BY
    date,
    SOURCE,
    medium,
    google_ad_network,
    country,
    campaign,
    Data_Source_type ),
  transformations AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN (data_source_type = "adwords" OR data_source_type='Google Ads') AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(google_ad_network,"content|google display network|youtube") THEN "google - external display"
      WHEN data_source_type = "criteo" THEN "criteo - external display"
      WHEN data_source_type = "yahoo_japan_ydn" THEN "yahoo - external display"
      WHEN data_source_type = "yahoo_japan_search" THEN "yahoo - sea"
      WHEN (data_source_type = "adwords" OR data_source_type='Google Ads') AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(google_ad_network,"content|google display network") THEN "google - sea"
      WHEN (data_source_type = "adwords"
      OR data_source_type='Google Ads')
    AND google_ad_network IS NULL THEN "google - sea"
      WHEN (data_source_type = "bing" OR data_source_type = "Microsoft Advertising") THEN "bing - sea"
      WHEN data_source_type = "facebookads" THEN "facebook - paid social"
      WHEN (data_source_type = "twitter" OR data_source_type="X Ads") THEN "twitter - paid social"
      WHEN data_source_type = "linkedin_api" THEN "linkedin - paid social"
      ELSE NULL
  END
    AS sub_channels
  FROM
    main )
    -- final table
SELECT
  *,
  CASE
    WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(sub_channels, '- sea') THEN "sea"
    WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(sub_channels, 'paid social') THEN "paid social"
    WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(sub_channels, 'email|etocs') THEN "email"
    WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(sub_channels, 'external display') THEN "external display"
    WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(sub_channels, 'internal display') THEN "internal display"
    ELSE "6. other channels"
END
  AS main_channels
FROM
  transformations

WITH
  main_data AS (
  SELECT
    * EXCEPT(Session_source__medium___GA4__Google_Analytics,
      Session_campaign___GA4__Google_Analytics),
    LOWER(Session_campaign___GA4__Google_Analytics) AS campaign,
    TRIM(SPLIT(Session_source__medium___GA4__Google_Analytics, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(0)]) AS SOURCE,
    TRIM(SPLIT(Session_source__medium___GA4__Google_Analytics, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(1)]) AS medium
  FROM
    `snproject-cbb9ca25`.`dbt_dev_ga4_ria_researcher_report`.`journal_mapping`
    
   
  WHERE date BETWEEN 
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-01') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )
        AND
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-05') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )

  ),
  
  marbl_data AS (
  SELECT
    DISTINCT SOURCE AS marbl_source,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(Campaign) IS NULL THEN 'no_campaign'
      ELSE LOWER(Campaign)
    END AS marbl_campaign,
    medium AS marbl_medium,
    "" AS marbl_adcontent,
    LOWER(country) AS marbl_country,
    CAST(SubmitDate AS date) AS submit_date,
    COUNT(UniqueSubmissionID) AS kpi_marbl_leads
  FROM
    `snproject-cbb9ca25`.`ga4_ria_researcher_report`.`BooksMarketing`
    
  WHERE CAST(SubmitDate AS date) BETWEEN 
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-01') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )
        AND
        COALESCE(
          DATE('2025-01-05') ,
          DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
        )

  GROUP BY
    campaign,
    SOURCE,
    medium,
    submit_date,
    country ),
  
  combined_data AS (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM
    main_data AS main
  FULL JOIN
    marbl_data AS marbl
  ON
    LOWER(main.campaign) = LOWER(marbl_campaign)
    AND main.source = marbl_source
    AND main.medium = marbl_medium
    AND main.Date = marbl.submit_date
    AND main.Country___GA4__Google_Analytics = marbl.marbl_country
  ),
  
  unified_data AS (
  SELECT
    * EXCEPT(date,
      marbl_campaign,
      marbl_source,
      marbl_medium,
      marbl_country,
      campaign,
      SOURCE,
      medium,
      Country___GA4__Google_Analytics,
      submit_date,
      Session_manual_ad_content___GA4__Google_Analytics,
      marbl_adcontent),
    COALESCE(Date, submit_date) AS date,
    COALESCE(campaign, marbl_campaign) AS campaign,
    COALESCE(SOURCE, marbl_source) AS SOURCE,
    COALESCE(medium, marbl_medium) AS medium,
    COALESCE(Session_manual_ad_content___GA4__Google_Analytics, marbl_adcontent) AS Ad_content___GA4__Google_Analytics,
    COALESCE(Country___GA4__Google_Analytics, marbl_country) AS country
  FROM
    combined_data ),
  
  row_number AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY date, campaign, SOURCE, medium, Ad_content___GA4__Google_Analytics, country ORDER BY date DESC) AS RN
  FROM
    unified_data )
  
SELECT
